author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Call for Illustrators - Stickers on Participation & Democracy
content: SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026. No Generative AI. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio.

author: Puffball Comics
title: Artist Call for Abida - Line Art Finishing Artist
content: ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2. We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel. What you'll be working on: Finishing and refining line art / inks, Supporting the completion of illustrated pages, Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches. If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk
